newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN SERVICES 9.1 PERCENT UP IN OCTOBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN SERVICES 9.1 PERCENT UP IN OCTOBER.

text.p: Romania's October commercial services stood at 405.4 billion lei, rising by 9.1 percent from the previous month in real terms, data issued by the National Statistics Board (CNS) showed on Monday.
The CNS said services in October were 6.3 percent down year on year.
Ten-month services, amounting to 3.02 trillion lei, were a slight 1.0 percent up from the year-ago period.
Data refer to commercial services to the population and exclude transport, mail and telecoms.
The private sector took 73.9 percent of 10-month services, up from 73 percent in the equivalent period of 1995. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($=3,508 lei)
